source_findings: Every card used ControlList.addItem, rebinding the complete rail each time
Every card title was rasterized before any page items were bound
Navigation cleared visited lists and showed CONNECTING before cache lookup
Catalog and hover detail calls shared a provider lock
Account guards took SQLite writer transactions for read checks
changes: Native WindowXML list with one bind per page and selected-index preservation
Memory view snapshots, epoch-scoped saved first pages and shared in-flight requests
Bounded warm-up for Home/Movies/TV and their first two actual server pages
Separate primary reader lane from legacy detail/playback provider
Focus dwell before one metadata lookup; no automatic season traversal
Focused/nearby title plates and ten-card artwork read-ahead off the navigation path
Read-only account guard transactions; cached account files still purged on sign-out
Actual-run network, cache, bind, title and artwork timing diagnostics
limitations: Cold uncached provider requests retain real network latency
No invented pagination endpoints or silent provider substitution
Real device timings come from the combined diagnostic report
